name: cropper
title: Cropper
description: A picture with a box over it that says what to keep.
use: A reader chooses the part of a picture to keep: a photo cropped before it is posted, a cover trimmed to a banner's proportions, an avatar framed in a circle. The value is a rectangle in the picture's own pixels; cutting the picture is the application's.

instead.when: The picture is shown, not cropped
Two versions of one picture are compared
A picture is opened large to look at

keyboard.action: Move the crop by a step of the picture's pixels, a hundredth of its longer side by default; ten steps with Shift
Make the crop wider or taller from its far edge, both at a ratio; on a panned cropper, zoom out
Make the crop narrower or shorter from its far edge, both at a ratio; on a panned cropper, zoom in
On a panned cropper, zoom in or out about the middle of the box

platform.feature: Size container queries on the box
platform.fallback: The handles of the edges stay on a box too small to hold them apart from the corners; the corners are still on top

classes.name: cropper
classes.description: The frame: a well that holds the picture --cropper-inset in from its edge, and the box over it. The whole frame takes the pointer

classes.name: cropper-pan
classes.description: The box stays in the middle of the frame, at the proportions of --cropper-ratio, and the picture pans and zooms under it

classes.name: cropper-round
classes.description: The box is a circle, or an ellipse inside a box that is not square: for an avatar

classes.name: cropper-image
classes.description: The picture. Its width and height are the file's own size in pixels: the crop is counted in them

classes.name: cropper-box
classes.description: The crop: one tab stop that the arrow keys move and size, placed from the four properties. It dims the picture outside it and shows the rule of thirds while it is held or keyed

classes.name: cropper-handle
classes.description: A handle a pointer drags: a 24px target, 44px on a coarse pointer, with a pearl pill on an edge and a pearl disc on a corner. Its modifiers name the edges it moves

classes.name: cropper-handle-top
classes.description: The handle moves the top edge

classes.name: cropper-handle-bottom
classes.description: The handle moves the bottom edge

classes.name: cropper-handle-left
classes.description: The handle moves the left edge

classes.name: cropper-handle-right
classes.description: The handle moves the right edge

classes.name: cropper-status
classes.description: A polite live region, hidden but read: the script writes the crop's size into it after each change

states.name: held
states.description: While the box, a handle or the panned picture is held, the rule of thirds shows

states.name: focused
states.description: A white ring outside the box, and the rule of thirds

states.name: disabled
states.description: The handles leave and the crop takes no pointer and no key

properties.name: --cropper-x
properties.description: The crop's left edge, as a share of the picture's width from 0 to 1; the script writes it

properties.name: --cropper-y
properties.description: The crop's top edge, as a share of the picture's height

properties.name: --cropper-width
properties.description: The crop's width, as a share of the picture's width

properties.name: --cropper-height
properties.description: The crop's height, as a share of the picture's height

properties.name: --cropper-ratio
properties.description: Width over height of a panned box. The script writes the ratio it keeps here, and reads one written in markup

properties.name: --cropper-inset
properties.description: The room between the picture and the frame: 1.375rem on a coarse pointer, so a handle on the picture's edge stays whole, and 1.5rem around a panned box

properties.name: --cropper-target
properties.description: The size of a handle's target; 2.75rem on a coarse pointer. The mark drawn in it keeps its size
